coverage.description: State (character vector, cursor, tokens) advances left to right. Numeric runs admit digits and dots, then an optional well-formed exponent suffix. Alphabetic/underscore starts identifiers; bracket/equality/multiplication/minus specials precede the ordered symbol table. Unknown characters return Err with no token vector. Recognized aliases collapse to canonical Sym tokens.
